homeAboutP1: Art Kids in Politics is a podcast made by students who think the arts and politics were never separate. We sit down, disagree a little, and work through the issues that shape our country and our generation.
homeAboutP2: We made it because we kept having these conversations anyway. They deserved a microphone.
aboutPull: We're students. We have opinions, doubts, and a lot of questions.
aboutWhat: Art Kids in Politics is a student podcast about art, politics, culture and society. Every episode starts with a question we can't stop thinking about, and ends with us a little less sure and a lot more curious.
aboutWhy: Because the art kids were always the ones noticing what was wrong, and nobody was asking us. Write your own story here: the moment it started, the conversation that sparked it.
aboutTalk: Art that pushes back, policies that affect our lives, the culture we scroll through, and the society we're about to inherit. Always from a young South African point of view.
aboutFor: Students, creatives, the politically curious, and anyone who's ever been told they're too young to have a view. If that's you, pull up a chair.

topics.Art: How we make, read and argue with images
topics.Politics: Power, policy and who gets heard
topics.Youth: What it is to be young right now
topics.Culture: The stories and habits that shape us
topics.Society: Safety, justice and the world we share
